content.note: One-off extra post (Fri 20 Nov), before the CHRIST application deadline of 25 Nov 2026.

caption:
Save this before 25 Nov 📌

Your CHRIST route map for 2027. One entrance test, three BBA stops:

🔵 BBA
🔵 BBA (Hons)
🔵 BBA (Hons with Research)

The selection line:
🟣 Last date to apply: 25 Nov 2026
🟣 Christ University Entrance Test: 5 Dec 2026
🟣 Skill assessment, micro presentation and interview: 11 to 13 Dec 2026
🟣 Final list: 21 Dec 2026

Apply only on the official CHRIST portal.

Writing CHRIST alongside IPMAT? Tell us in the comments 👇
Send this to the friend who still hasn't filled the form.

#ChristUniversity #BBA2027 #IPMAT2027 #IPMCareers
